description: B4 stale hits, the attacker's half: a line of light and heavy laser towers at x 4985, y 6983 on Town & Country (three seats and more; the commanders start far from it), owned by the peer that applies it. Apply it on one peer and b4-victims on another, repeatedly (every few seconds), so the victims' owner keeps creating into the slots the towers keep freeing; with tagpu_dmgdelay.on=K on the attacker every hit it sends is K ticks late. Laser hits are instant, so every shot is one 0x0B; two fusion plants pay for the shots (a laser tower spends energy on each, and a game's starting income fires them a few times a second).
